  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases suggest practical setup and maintenance needs, such as wired connectivity, desk organization, cleaning and carrying equipment.",
    "Accessories that complement what I already use are more appealing right now than duplicates or hardware that needs an unconfirmed compatible system."
